title: Fractions, percentages and units - 123 school
heading: Fractions, percentages and units
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
All the data you need is in the question. Every question tells you how to round.

questions.q: Write the fraction 10/15 as simply as possible.

questions.e: Dividing by 1: 5 g per 1 mL = 5 g/mL

questions.q: What does a concentration of 25 g/L mean?
questions.a: 1 L of solution contains 25 g of dissolved substance
questions.e: You read g/L as "grams per litre": 1 L contains 25 g

questions.q: You divide a mass in g by a volume in mL. What unit does the answer have?
You divide a distance in km by a time in h. What unit does the answer have?
An object covers 100 m in 12 s. Calculate the speed in m/s. Round to 1 decimal place.
A mixture contains 20% of a substance. How many grams of that substance are there in 100 g of the mixture?
questions.e: In 100 g there is 20%: 20% of 100 g = 20 g

questions.q: A quantity of 150 g increases by 20%. How many grams is it afterwards? You do not need to round.
A mixture consists of 15 g of sand and 6 g of salt. What is the mass ratio sand : salt?
Convert 25 mg to g. You do not need to round.
Convert 1234 g to kg. Round to 1 decimal place.
questions.e: 1 kg = 1000 g, so 1234 g = 1.234 kg, rounded 1.2 kg

questions.q: Convert 3 min to s. You do not need to round.
Which volume is equal to 1 dm<sup>3</sup>?
